blocks.text:
**Duration:** 7 days / 6 nights  
**Dates:** 12–18 February 2027  
**Route:** Rio de Janeiro, 3 nights + Foz do Iguaçu, 3 nights  
**Format:** Group tour with an English-speaking guide

## Prices and hotels

Prices in US dollars per person for the full programme. SGL means single occupancy, DBL double occupancy and TRP triple occupancy. Breakfast is included; hotels may be replaced by others of the same category.

| Category | Rio de Janeiro + Foz do Iguaçu | SGL | DBL | TRP |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|
| 3* | ibis Copacabana Posto 5 + Viale Tower | $3,725 | $2,688 | $2,650 |
| 4* | Windsor Leme + Vivaz Cataratas Deluxe | $4,504 | $3,014 | $2,790 |
| 5* | Miramar by Windsor + Doubletree by Hilton Foz | $5,261 | $3,562 | $3,263 |

Carnival tickets and hotel – Sambadrome – hotel transfers are included. International flights and domestic flights Rio – Iguazu – Rio are charged separately; domestic flights cost from $500 per person.

## Trip highlights

The evening of Day 2 is devoted to the Parade of Champions at the Sambadrome. After the samba schools perform, a transfer takes the group back to the hotel.

You see Rio from two heights: Sugar Loaf and Corcovado. The programme also includes the historic centre, a train ride through the Tijuca Forest and the statue of Christ the Redeemer. In your free time, you can watch the sunset at Arpoador or visit the Marius restaurant at an additional cost.

The second part of the journey takes you to Iguazu: panoramic views of the cascades from Brazil and a walk through the Argentine national park to the Devil’s Throat. The Macuco Safari, Bird Park and a helicopter flight over the falls are available at an additional cost. A beach stay in Búzios can be arranged separately after the tour.
